title: concordium-identity
description: What Concordium says about the seller of an x402 payment: the payTo account's identity credential and, when the paid endpoint's Agent Card shows a Concordium badge, that agent in the Agent Registry (CIS-8004); and, when the seller serves one, a zero-knowledge proof about the person behind its payTo. Carried in x402 /verify and /settle answers as extensions["concordium-identity"] and returned by GET /identity. Read-only facts, never a score.

outcome.description: verified-agent: payTo is the agent wallet of an active, registered agent whose anchored card lists the paid endpoint's origin. identity-backed: no verified agent, but payTo has a valid identity credential. expired: payTo's identity credential has expired. not-read: nothing could be read (node or registry unreachable); never a pass or a fail.

credential.description: The payTo account's first identity credential, read from the node (account info). Absent when it could not be read.

provider.description: The identity provider's name from the chain (getIdentityProviders), or "identity provider <n>".

validTo.description: The credential's policy.validTo as YYYY-MM; valid through the end of that month.

revealed.description: Attributes the account itself revealed on chain (policy.revealedAttributes), or null. Nothing else about the person is shown.

agent.description: Present when the paid endpoint's origin serves /.well-known/agent-card.json with a Concordium badge.

tokenAddress.description: The badge: the agent's CIS-2 token address in the registry.

outcome.description: verified-wallet: payTo is the registered agent wallet. owner-only: no agent wallet is set and payTo is the owner. mismatch: payTo is not the agent's wallet. revoked: the agent is not Active. card-mismatch: the card at agent_uri doesn't hash to the metadata_hash on chain. endpoint-unlisted: the anchored card doesn't list this origin (a copied badge proves nothing). other-network: the badge belongs to another network's registry. not-read: the registry or the anchored card could not be read.

reason.description: Why the outcome is not verified-wallet, in plain words.

proof.description: Present when the paid endpoint's origin serves /.well-known/concordium-proof.json: a zero-knowledge proof, made in the owner's Concordium wallet, about the identity behind the payTo account, for the challenge sha256("concordium-x402-seller-proof:v1|<network>|<origin>|<payTo>"). verified: it is for this network, site and payTo, the proofs verify against the chain, and the credential is one of the payTo account's own; facts are what the verified statements establish. Nothing else about the person is known to the facilitator.

facts.description: adult: 18 or older; eu-residence / eu-nationality: country of residence / nationality in the EU; id-document-valid: the identity document was valid on the day of the proof, and that day is today or later.

issuer.description: The identity provider's index on the network.

credential.description: The payTo account's credential id that made the proof (hex).
